ائتكلن (form VIII)
# اِئْتَكَلْنَ (iʔtakalna) /iʔ.ta.kal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# اِئْتَكِلْنَ (iʔtakilna) /iʔ.ta.kil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
